+@pytest.mark.parametrize("explicit_cause", [True, False])
+def test_application_exception_preserves_cause_or_context(
+    test_client_factory: TestClientFactory, explicit_cause: bool
+) -> None:
+    cause = ValueError("cause")
+
+    async def error_endpoint(_: Request) -> None:
+        try:
+            raise cause
+        except ValueError:
+            if explicit_cause:
+                raise RuntimeError("application") from cause
+            raise RuntimeError("application")
+
+    async def passthrough(request: Request, call_next: RequestResponseEndpoint) -> Response:
+        return await call_next(request)
+
+    app = Starlette(
+        middleware=[Middleware(BaseHTTPMiddleware, dispatch=passthrough)],
+        routes=[Route("/", error_endpoint)],
+    )
+
+    client = test_client_factory(app)
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="application") as exc_info:
+        client.get("/")
+
+    chained_exception = exc_info.value.__cause__ if explicit_cause else exc_info.value.__context__
+    assert chained_exception is cause
+
